stem: Eklavya compares the calendar for year $P$ with the calendar for year $Q$. He wants to know when year $P$'s calendar can be reused for year $Q$.

options.text: Year $P$'s calendar can be reused when every date falls on the same weekday in year $Q$.
Matching only one date's weekday is enough to reuse the whole calendar.
The calendar can be reused because year $Q$ is written with larger digits than year $P$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A year's calendar repeats only when all dates and days match exactly with those of the other year.

teacher.key_rationale: Reuse requires the whole calendar to match day-for-date across the year. One matching date or larger year digits are not enough.
